name: Corrosion-resistant alloys and clad pipe
principle: Duplex stainless steels combine high chromium and nitrogen with lower nickel, giving chloride resistance and about twice the yield strength of austenitic grades. Cladding bonds a corrosion-resistant layer to a carbon steel base.

process_steps.name: Select grade by PREN and strength
Roll-bond or explosion-bond the cladding, or weld overlay
Inspect for sigma phase and defects
